description: Save a structure as a plan before building it, and check the plan: palette characters map to blocks with the properties that matter ("S": "oak_stairs[facing=north,half=bottom]"), layers go bottom-up, each layer is rows north → south and each row is columns west → east. ' ' = any block (not checked), '.' = must stay empty (doorways, head room, the cell a door opens into, windows). Only the properties you write are checked later, so pin facing/half/axis/hinge where they matter. A stair climbs toward its facing: on a roof every stair faces the ridge (the north slope faces south), half=top turns it upside down. spots are places to stand (plan coordinates x = column, y = layer, z = row) that must be reachable on foot from the first one — e.g. an entrance outside, the bed, the chest. rotate turns the whole plan clockwise (properties included); origin is the lowest north-west corner after turning. Answers with size, materials vs inventory and warnings (a door opening into a wall, a torch on nothing, a stair without facing). With only name, shows a saved plan.
name: build_plan
title: Save a build plan
